It drives the same ckt24 circuit (set mode=yearly number=100) with the same substation regulator as the -mm sibling master_ckt24.dss, so it inherits the same real blocker: the RegControl/LDC tap-trajectory current divergence on Transformer.SubXFMR / Regcontrol.SubXFMR_Regulator (see the sibling entry above). Not a file-array feature gap. Not forced into solvable_now.

WPG.19 (2026-07-11) removed the former blocker (non-MM file-backed arrays LS_PhaseB/C/ThreePhase/Other_Bus_Load, mult=(file=...) action=normalize): the deck now COMPILES + CONVERGES (yearly, number=100; hour=100, 2 iters, 7522 nodes) and its full complex node V matches the pinned oracle to 5.6e-8 rel max / 2.8e-8 median (faer-vs-KLU floor) after the entire 100-step trajectory -- so the load shapes are read/driven identically. NEW true blocker (live mismatch, NOT WPG.19): the regulator-controlled substation transformer diverges at the per-element current level -- Transformer.SubXFMR (Regcontrol.SubXFMR_Regulator winding=2 vreg=123 band=3 R=7 LDC, delay=45) currents differ |diff|=7.2e-4 A (~4.7e-5 rel) at step 0 after the yearly trajectory, exceeding the large-tier current tolerance while V stays regulated to floor. This is the known RegControl/LDC tap-trajectory divergence family (MEMORY: AutoTrans/RegControl stale tap, needs_investigation), unrelated to the file arrays. Not forced into solvable_now. Also note the regcontrol has debugtrace=yes (writes REG_subxfmr_regulator.csv each run).

ROOT-CAUSED 2026-07-10 (user-directed deck audit): the deck data itself is pathological, no engine solves it as vendored. The 480 V DER microgrid island (m2001der480-2 delta secondary of a 750 kVA xfmr) is operated at the edge of voltage collapse, and Storage.battery1 (state=charging) / battery2 (idling) tip the snapshot power flow over the fixed-point stability boundary: |V| at M2001-ESS1 grows geometrically (~x2000/iteration; 6.97e4 -> 6.35e6 -> 1.26e10 V...) until NaN. Bisected: both batteries disabled -> converges (121 iterations -- still extremely marginal vs the usual 5-15); battery1=discharging -> converges (130); charging or idling -> geometric divergence. Engine-lineage-consistent: pinned oracle, official EPRI r3723/r4088/r4133, and the Rust port all diverge identically on the vendored deck, and on the healed variant (storages disabled) Rust converges in EXACTLY the oracle's 121 iterations. Deck/scenario bug (DERs likely meant to be coordinated/disabled by a separate scenario file), nothing to fix port-side. The earlier 'no JSON response' was a secondary serialization glitch of the NaN state.
